name: furniturerx-functions
description: Netlify Functions for Furniture-Rx (checkout + Stripe webhook). The site itself is a single static index.html.

scripts.gate:baseline: npm run build && node tools/gate/norm-hash.mjs dist/index.html > tools/gate/baseline.d2c.sha256
scripts.test:e2e: node tools/tests/e2e-kiosk.mjs && node tools/tests/e2e-account.mjs && node tools/tests/e2e-d2c.mjs && node tools/tests/e2e-tech.mjs && node tools/tests/e2e-subportal.mjs && node tools/tests/e2e-circuit.mjs && node tools/tests/e2e-responsive.mjs && node tools/tests/e2e-stripe-onboard.mjs && node tools/tests/e2e-resources.mjs && node tools/tests/e2e-kit-orders.mjs
